name: Al-Harith ibn Ubbad
bio: Al-Harith was a horseman and poet of Bakr ibn Wa'il. The tribal histories say he became chief of Banu Dubay'a as a young man. In accounts of the Basus War he keeps out of the fighting between Bakr and Taghlib until al-Muhalhil kills Bujayr and puts a sandal strap’s price on his life. His return to the field is remembered in the verses calling for his mare al-Na'ama. Al-Zirikli places his death about fifty years before the Hijra (around 570 CE).
